title: LA 2028
sub: The Games of the XXXIV Olympiad · Los Angeles
timeNote: LA is 17 hours behind Sydney — morning sessions in LA land in Australian evenings, evening finals in our mornings. The same shape as the NFL: sport in your morning coffee.

facts.l: sports — a Games record, with cricket, flag football, baseball/softball, lacrosse and squash added
Australia's best-ever medal haul was Paris 2024 — 18 gold, 53 total, 4th on the table

milestones.what: Qualification windows open across most sports
LA28 publishes the full competition schedule and ticketing opens
Australian Olympic team named after the swimming and athletics trials
Opening Ceremony — split between the LA Memorial Coliseum and SoFi Stadium
